Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Maurice Tarplin is credited on 277 distinct recordings across 12 programs from 1938-10-30 through 1965-05-19. Documented roles include performer on 277 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Boston Blackie (performer on 183 recordings; 183 distinct recordings), The Mysterious Traveler (performer on 65 recordings; 65 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 9 recordings; 9 distinct recordings), Theater Five (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), The Shadow (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), Words at War (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), Columbia Workshop (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), and Cloak and Dagger (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Inspector Faraday (183 portrayals), The Mysterious Traveler (65 portrayals), and Hercule Poirot (1 portrayals).
